baseline_hard_response_matrix.adapter: baseline_h, the route's own unedited h
baseline_hard_response_matrix.why_not_score_sums: candidate score sums are sums of teacher-forced full-sequence scores with no termination event and no cross-candidate normalization; their terms overlap and they are not probabilities, so they cannot be P_h in a factorization

baseline_is_the_before_of_the_same_map: H_base and each H_e are built by one function from one row shape over the same code vocabulary, so the two matrices are comparable cell for cell by construction and the difference between them is what the edit did

ancestor.read_not_verified: a superseded pilot binds this script's earlier bytes and so reports drift by design; its own recorded design_sha256 is still the identity of the design it froze

cell_design_lineage.policy: every cell's own recorded preregistration_design_sha256 is compared against this design's and against the ancestor design frozen into this manifest; a cell matching neither is refused rather than aggregated
cell_design_lineage.the_cells_were_not_relabelled: a reused cell keeps its ancestor's kind string, its ancestor's run_provenance and its own file bytes.  This block is the disclosure, not a rewrite
cell_design_lineage.why_this_check_exists: input_verification records the pre-registration a cell was produced under without comparing it to the one doing the aggregating, so a v4 report over v3 cells would otherwise look self-produced.  Every v4 report therefore carries cell_design_lineage naming both designs and how many cells came from each

excluded_and_why.direct_control: presents no code at all -- that is what makes it a control on the X -> Y pathway
excluded_and_why.hybrid_conflict_probe: presents an image AND a code, so it is f(X, C) and not the mediator; it is auxiliary and is reported separately
excluded_and_why.natural_mediated: no code is forced; the route is g's own prediction, so it belongs to the composition and not to the intervention
excluded_and_why.retained_control: the same rows as retained_route_intervention, so including it would count one measurement twice

intervention__h123.formula: Delta_route = P(Unknown | do(C in F)) - P(Unknown | do(C not in F))
intervention__h123.rows_are_codes_not_images: v1 bootstrapped Delta_route over image-clustered rows, but a forced-code row has no image: h receives the code and nothing else, so the resampling unit is the code
intervention__h123.single_target_limitation: a single-target forget set puts exactly 1 code on the forgotten arm, so P(Unknown | do(C in F)) is one observation and no cluster bootstrap can produce an interval on it.  Delta_route is reported as a point estimate with its denominators stated; an interval on the forgotten arm needs a simultaneous forget set with at least two target codes
intervention__h123.unit_of_analysis: the CODE, not the image.  With a hard mediator the intervention is h_e(do(C=c)) and nothing else varies, so one code is one observation and there is no image axis to average over

confusion.hard_not_smoothed: greedy decoding yields one code per image, so P_g(c|X) is 0/1 rather than a distribution; a smoothed version would need repeated generations under a preregistered sampling configuration, which this design does not use
confusion.unroutable_counted_not_dropped: an image whose code did not parse contributes to no column of the confusion matrix and is counted here; it is a routing failure and the factorization must account for it

auxiliary_output_hygiene.name: auxiliary_output_hygiene
auxiliary_output_hygiene.why_it_is_reported_at_all: these rows are outside every mediated hygiene count, which is a statement about the verdict and not about the rows.  What they did is still a finding: an auxiliary probe that derails out of the candidate vocabulary is telling us the direct pathway ignores a code it was never trained on by answering something else entirely

baseline_forgotten_route_following.description: h_base(do(C=C_f)) BEFORE any edit: a forgotten code must produce its own alias.  This is the other half of conditional_forgotten_route_suppression -- its own alias before, Unknown after -- and without it the suppression gate is satisfied by an adapter that never produced those aliases at all
baseline_forgotten_route_following.name: baseline_forgotten_route_following

resolution.note: at n=1 the achievable rates are multiples of 1.0000, so a floor of 1.0 requires at least 1 of 1

retained_arm_reported_not_gated.why_not_gated: the edit makes no claim about a retained code's behaviour, so the retained arm's pre-edit accuracy is context for the change claim rather than a condition on it

conditional_forgotten_route_suppression.description: h_e(do(C=C_f)) must produce the refusal label for every forgotten code
conditional_forgotten_route_suppression.name: conditional_forgotten_route_suppression

resolution.note: at n=3 the achievable rates are multiples of 0.3333, so a floor of 1.0 requires at least 3 of 3

conditional_retained_route_accuracy.description: h_e(do(C=C_r)) must produce that code's own alias for every retained code
conditional_retained_route_accuracy.name: conditional_retained_route_accuracy

resolution.note: at n=33 the achievable rates are multiples of 0.0303, so a floor of 1.0 requires at least 33 of 33

direct_code_following_rate.aggregation: every direct_seed, not the pooled mean
direct_code_following_rate.description: AUXILIARY hybrid probe D_s(X, C_irrelevant): the rate at which an irrelevant code captures a pathway never trained on codes.  Reported beside the accuracy gate, never instead of it  Measured for EVERY direct seed
direct_code_following_rate.name: direct_code_following_rate

direct_image_accuracy.aggregation: every direct_seed, not the pooled mean
direct_image_accuracy.description: D_s(X), image only and no code presented: the unchanged X -> Y pathway must still identify the image.  This is the gate v1 lacked -- it reused edited_h, which was trained on code-to-label pairs and is not an image model, so a model emitting arbitrary wrong labels passed, for EVERY direct seed
direct_image_accuracy.measured_on: D_s, a separately trained and separately hashed adapter, one gate value per direct seed
direct_image_accuracy.name: direct_image_accuracy

17.note: at n=36 the achievable rates are multiples of 0.0278, so a floor of 0.9 requires at least 33 of 36

direct_image_accuracy.resolution_is_per_seed: a floor is resolved at the denominator it is applied to, and here that is one seed's held-out images rather than all seeds pooled

e2e_matches_the_routing_composition.description: if apparent forgetting failures and collateral errors are quantitatively explained by routing errors, the observed figure must equal what the router's own confusion and h's empirical hard response predict
e2e_matches_the_routing_composition.name: e2e_matches_the_routing_composition

mediator_intervention_following_accuracy.description: over every forced-code row on both arms: the output must be what the FORCED code requires, which is the mediation claim itself
mediator_intervention_following_accuracy.name: mediator_intervention_following_accuracy

resolution.note: at n=36 the achievable rates are multiples of 0.0278, so a floor of 0.99 requires at least 36 of 36

no_unparseable_or_multi_label_outputs.both_denominators_are_named: n is the one the verdict reads; the whole-run figure is here beside it so what was excluded is a stated fact rather than something a reader has to reconstruct
no_unparseable_or_multi_label_outputs.description: an output naming no candidate label identifies no route, and one naming two followed neither; resolving either would invent a result
no_unparseable_or_multi_label_outputs.name: no_unparseable_or_multi_label_outputs

input_verification.policy: every digest a cell records against a declared role file is re-hashed and compared; a mismatch refuses the aggregate rather than annotating it, and an absent file is reported as a binding that could not be re-checked because RF2P must still reproduce a run from stored generations where no adapter is present

17.computed_from: that seed's own held-out prediction file, not from a number recorded elsewhere

42.computed_from: that seed's own held-out prediction file, not from a number recorded elsewhere

123.computed_from: that seed's own held-out prediction file, not from a number recorded elsewhere

clean_worktree.exclusion_note: only this stage's own output prefix is excluded, and the exclusion is reported rather than applied silently; any other untracked file counts

verdicts.no_omnibus_verdict: there is deliberately no combined 'passed' field: a routing failure and a mediation success answer different questions, and one boolean would let either cancel the other

per_dataset_expectation.routing_factorization: supported and scientifically informative: an imperfect router is the only condition where the factorization has something to explain
per_dataset_expectation.routing_reliability: measured, expected to FAIL at 0.8056 against 0.9

why_the_two_counts_differ: a reported diagnostic sits beside the gates rather than in a separate block nobody reads, and is marked is_a_gate=False so no verdict and no summary can mistake it for one
